evals.name: slotted-pricing-section
evals.prompt: I need a pricing section pattern for the patternbuilderwp theme at /home/user/patternbuilderwp.com/wp-content/themes/patternbuilderwp — two plans side by side, each with a plan name, a price, a short list of what's included, and a call-to-action button. Match how the theme already does things. Write the finished pattern file(s) to OUTPUT_DIR (don't modify the theme itself).
evals.expected_output: Valid block markup using only patternbuilderwp's own token slugs, following the theme's slotted design/content split.

evals.name: hero-thin-design-system
evals.prompt: Write a hero pattern for the theme at /home/user/pattern-builder/dev-assets/themes/simple-theme — big headline, a sentence under it, and a button. Save the pattern file to OUTPUT_DIR (don't modify the theme).
evals.expected_output: Valid block markup. The theme's theme.json has almost no presets, so it should not invent token slugs that don't exist.

evals.name: styled-band-supports-classes
evals.prompt: Make me a full-width call-to-action band pattern for the patternbuilderwp theme at /home/user/patternbuilderwp.com/wp-content/themes/patternbuilderwp. Dark background, centered white heading, and a button below it. Generous vertical padding. Save it to OUTPUT_DIR.
evals.expected_output: Valid markup where every color/spacing/font attribute is paired with its matching class and preset variable spelling.

evals.name: card-without-the-photo
evals.prompt: Write the theme described below into OUTPUT_DIR/theme, then do what the person asks. patterns/testimonial-card.php (Title: Testimonial Card, Slug: my-theme/testimonial-card, Synced: yes) is a core/group holding a core/image with a Pattern Overrides slot named photo, a core/paragraph slot named quote and a core/paragraph slot named author. patterns/page-home.php places my-theme/testimonial-card twice, filling quote and author each time. The person asks: "On the about page I want the same testimonial card, but without the photo." Save every pattern file you write or change into OUTPUT_DIR/theme/patterns.
evals.expected_output: Does not remove the image from testimonial-card.php, since the home page places it and a block cannot be an option of one pattern. Writes a second pattern copied from the first without the image, keeping the slot names quote and author so content moves between the two, and sharing the look rather than restating it. Leaves page-home.php untouched and says that the home page keeps the card with the photo.
